description: Minimal M2M with client_secret_post, 300-second access tokens and empty scopes. Default benchmark profile checks HS256; provisioning sets the dedicated Keycloak client to HS256. Authentik uses a pre-created service account/app password encoded in client_secret. Legacy provider-secret automatic-account mode must be explicitly selected and measured separately. Native claim and extra-token work remains part of measured cost.

keycloak.aud: Explicit benchmark-client audience, required for usable token introspection in the pinned Keycloak version.

authentik.id_token: Pinned Authentik returns an ID token even for empty-scope client_credentials. This is additional native issuance work, retained in timings and response size; these are not equivalent single-token operations.
